use a per-image four-point projective homography in memory for normalized intra-LCD landmark comparison

hold: physical millimetre calibration or device-face metrology
OEM RGB, glyph, font, detent or bezel/control geometry conformity
saved or redistributed cropped/warped OEM-reference derivatives

hardware, firmware, rights or release approval

coordinateDiscipline.cornerDefinition: intersection of locally fitted visible inner LCD aperture/active-display boundary lines; not hidden manufacturing glass/panel corners
coordinateDiscipline.uncertaintyMeaning: conservative approximate radial pixel uncertainty around each listed corner; includes rounded aperture ambiguity, glare/moiré and local edge-fit spread

method.edgeCrossCheck: read-only Scharr/Canny/Hough-style edge inspection plus robust local line fitting in narrow boundary bands seeded from direct visual inspection

photos.name: giaoDien.jpg
photos.occlusion: no LCD corner fully occluded; rounded inner aperture and dark top header make exact active-plane boundary non-singular
photos.cameraPerspective: mild projective skew; top/bottom widths are similar but right/left heights and bottom edge differ slightly

photos.name: lf.jpg
photos.occlusion: no LCD corner fully occluded; strong sonar texture and rounded aperture reduce edge uniqueness near top/left
photos.cameraPerspective: moderate; right visible side is longer than left and the top/bottom edges are not parallel in raw image space

photos.name: hf.jpg
photos.occlusion: no LCD corner fully occluded; lower and side boundaries are visually strong, top boundary still affected by rounded/dark aperture

photos.name: dual.jpg
photos.occlusion: no LCD corner fully occluded; active content reaches near borders and causes local competing edges
photos.cameraPerspective: moderate; left/right side lengths differ measurably in raw image space

photos.name: zoom.jpg
photos.occlusion: no LCD corner fully occluded; strong oblique top edge and bottom content/bloom make exact inner-plane edge moderately ambiguous
photos.cameraPerspective: moderate; top edge is visibly oblique and right side longer than left

photos.name: zoom2.jpg
photos.occlusion: no LCD corner fully occluded, but lower-left/lower edge has the largest local boundary ambiguity in this set due to perspective, rounded aperture and bright content
photos.cameraPerspective: moderate; top/bottom widths and bottom-edge slope differ enough that rectification is useful

photos.name: nav1.jpg
photos.occlusion: no LCD corner fully occluded; right-side sonar strip and lower border create competing vertical/horizontal transitions
photos.cameraPerspective: strongest left/right side-length asymmetry among the audited images; projective correction is useful but uncertainty must remain explicit

photos.name: nav2.jpg
photos.occlusion: no LCD corner fully occluded; visible boundaries are relatively strong, with the main ambiguity at the rounded top aperture
photos.cameraPerspective: moderate-to-strong top/bottom width change; per-image homography would materially normalize the LCD plane

perspectiveCrossCheck.purpose: show why per-image rectification helps without converting the JPEG into a physical calibration oracle
perspectiveCrossCheck.interpretation: non-equal opposite side lengths and oblique edges are consistent with camera perspective; these are image-space observations, not physical dimensions

homographyAssessment.validUse: rectify each visible LCD quadrilateral into an arbitrary normalized unit rectangle for comparing intra-LCD topology such as pane split, header bands, depth/readout placement and menu regions
invalidUses: mapping to 480x640 and then treating exact 480x640 agreement as independent evidence
converting normalized coordinates to millimetres without a coplanar calibrated scale
applying the LCD-plane homography to non-planar bezel, keys, pad or knobs
claiming lens distortion removal without camera calibration
claiming OEM pixel/RGB/font fidelity from a phone-camera photograph

evidenceLimitations: all four listed points are visible-image aperture/active-plane line intersections, not hidden physical panel manufacturing corners
rounded aperture and protective cover/glass can shift the apparent boundary by several pixels
moiré, glare, exposure and sonar/menu content create competing edges
camera pose changes across the eight photos; there is no shared camera calibration
no checkerboard, AprilTag, ruler or other coplanar scale target is present
a four-point projective transform does not model radial/tangential lens distortion
rights permit internal observation only; no saved crop/warp/derived OEM image is authorized for redistribution or served runtime
requiredBlockersForStrongerClaims: for physical/mm calibration: acquire a lawful photo with calibrated intrinsics and a known coplanar scale/target
for lower corner uncertainty: obtain a second independent blind point-pick or repeat capture with square-on camera and unoccluded sharp LCD boundary
for OEM framebuffer conformity: obtain lawful source-native framebuffer/reference data rather than camera JPEG
for distributable derived images: obtain explicit rights clearance
